traditional: A soft contact. Growth, fortune, and patronage supports limitation, delay, and hard structure - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas. The benefic Jupiter tempers the malefic Saturn.
modern: Expansion meets contraction. The swing between optimism and restraint, growth and discipline. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Ambition grounded by realism; you grow at a sustainable pace. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize growth and limit into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what growth and limit have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Balancing risk against prudence; unmanaged, it reads as inconsistency.
shadow: The ease lets excess and overreach and fear and rigidity go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.summary: A promising program receives conditional backing that can turn it into something lasting.
readerCopy.body: A promising program receives conditional backing that can turn it into something lasting. Jupiter sextile Saturn gives the expansion a workable route through the rules: revise the budget, meet the reporting requirement, narrow the scope, or secure the person responsible for delivery. The opportunity comes with proof requirements because the structure has to carry what is being promised. Treat those conditions as design information. Meet the requirement that matters and leave the parts that do not need to grow alone.
